title: StrictLocalMateProjectionFormulas
statement: For every f:X→S, geometric point s, K in D⁺(Ab(X_et)), integer n, and Q as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry], stage hypercohomology identifications compatible with neighbourhood transitions and the canonical mate projection restrictions exist [def-weil-pbc-small-model-mate-projection-data]. No colimit or invertibility assertion is made. All mate target comparisons in this statement use the small coordinate-ring colimit model of [def-weil-pbc-small-model-mate-projection-data].

source.place: Tags 03Q9, 03Q8 and 0BKV; neighbourhood colimit and final injective-complex paragraph

proof.text: Choose an injective representative J of K with the existing Mathlib theorem, and pass its isomorphism through the bounded-below inclusion.
Obtain source-to-termwise-sections isomorphisms A and their transition and mate-restriction formulas on J.

Obtain invertible canonical termwise-sections-to-hypercohomology comparisons c_i and their transition and projection squares. Define e_i as A_i followed by asIso c_i. Substitute the squares and cancel c_i followed by its inverse to prove transitions. Precompose the projection square with A_i and postcompose with the inverse strict-local target isomorphism to prove restriction. Assemble SmallModelStrictLocalMateProjectionData.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03Q9 final injective-complex paragraph, decomposition into source computation and target comparison; Lean assembly by composition and cancellation

mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about structure-sheaf stalks and ordinary module pullback; none realizes these abelian derived-section maps. Loogle presheafToSheaf, homology and IsPullback, IsAffineHom queries returned no hits.

Mathlib has general stalk and pullback infrastructure, but no strict-local derived mate or the canonical derived Hom-to-germ comparison. The existing AbelianHigherDirectImagePresheaf has private definitions of the comparison, inaccessible from another module.
